Garmin Forerunner 265 Running Smartwatch

$428.99
The Forerunner 265 is built for runners and athletes who want reliable, data-rich guidance without unnecessary complexity. The bright AMOLED touchscreen remains easy to read in direct sunlight, which is a big plus for outdoor workouts, and the traditional button controls give you quick access without navigating touch menus while moving. With up to 13 days in smartwatch mode, you can go days between charges, and up to 20 hours in GPS mode it covers long training sessions without worry. It’s a solid daily driver if you want accurate pace, distance, and heart rate metrics in a lightweight package. Be aware that while the interface is straightforward, some deeper features require time to learn in the Garmin ecosystem. If you’re serious about tracking progress, the level of insight here is worth the investment. Best for dedicated runners and fitness enthusiasts who want actionable metrics without subscription fees.
